author: dh2ix78
quote:
Beautiful Game, but the Story Isn't for Me 

I've been watching YouTube videos of my favorite streamers playing this game. I wanted to see how they played it and what they thought of the story. I was even looking forward to the PC version, supposedly coming in March. But after seeing more of the story, I've decided to skip it. And I want to explain why. First, I'm not saying this is a bad game. It genuinely looks beautiful, with really cool designs. The environments and characters clearly took a lot of effort. I can appreciate that, even if I don't enjoy the direction of the story. Good visuals just aren't enough for me. What really puts me off is the relationship drama. You have a character basically deciding, "You know what? I'm going to cheat on my boyfriend." And I'm sitting here thinking: seriously? I already deal with this kind of **** in real life. Why the **** would I want more of it in a game? I grew up with games that were simply fun. They offered fantasy, adventure, excitement, and escape. Now, some games feel like they're pushing propaganda or constantly reminding me of the worst parts of everyday life. Sometimes I want a fantasy, not another depiction of reality. People turn to games to escape that ****. Why bring so much of it into the worlds we're trying to enjoy? That doesn't mean every game needs to be cheerful. It just means this kind of story isn't what I'm looking for. And if this is your cup of tea, go ahead and enjoy it! I'm not telling anyone to stop playing or having fun. People are allowed to like things I don't. But if a story makes me uncomfortable before I even play, what's the point of spending money on it? Another disappointment is the lack of relationship choices. The first trailer showed several interesting female characters. A **** ton of people were excited about those designs. There was even that mosh-pit girl with the rocker, festival-girl aesthetic, who immediately caught my attention. She looked like someone with a fun personality to explore. It made me think we might get different relationship options, with different women and different personalities. Instead, it seems we're stuck with one main female character. And, frankly, not everyone likes her. I've seen people criticizing her, and I can understand why. Not everyone has the same taste in women. Some prefer a rocker girl; others want someone completely different. So why show all these interesting characters if the game gives us so little choice about romance? That feels like a massive missed opportunity. And the male protagonist isn't helping matters either. From what I've seen, he feels really two-dimensional. He's just doing basic chores and fixing up the house. At times, it looks like he renovates an entire home in one afternoon. How the hell is that realistic? Yes, she's in prison. Okay, cool, that's part of the story. But meanwhile, this guy is just fixing a house. It all looks strangely empty to me. Where's the personality or anything that makes him interesting? I don't mind slower games or everyday activities. Those things can be enjoyable if they're written well. But the way they're presented here doesn't grab me. I'm watching and wondering why I should care. That's not the feeling I want from a game. When the PC version arrives, I expect modders may step in. I wouldn't be surprised to see mods that supposedly "fix" the story problems that some players complain about. Maybe people will even try creating completely new storylines, or letting players romance characters they actually prefer. Whether huge story mods will be possible is another question. But I can see why people would want to try. For me, the final decision is pretty simple. It's a beautiful game, and I respect anyone who enjoys it. But its story, characters, and limited choices aren't for me. I want games that let me escape, have fun, and choose my path. I don't need another dose of real-life cheating and drama. If you love it, great! Enjoy yourself. I'm not calling it a bad game or telling you to stop. Personally, though, I'm skipping this one.
